{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured wool-blend blazer in charcoal, tailored fit with notched lapels and a single button closure, deep slate gray #2F4F4F, fine woven fabric.
High-waisted pleated trousers in mid-weight twill, straight-leg cut reaching the ankle, dark forest green #1A3C34, crisp cotton-polyester blend.
Silk-blend blouse with a pointed collar and subtle pintuck detailing across the chest, relaxed silhouette, muted rust #B85C38, smooth semi-sheer fabric.
Leather loafers with a slight wedge heel, rounded toe and minimal branding, matte black #260000, full-grain leather.
Matte-finish structured handbag in deep burgundy, rectangular silhouette with gold-tone hardware, soft pebbled leather.
Pearl-drop stud earrings, 925 sterling silver post, round freshwater pearl pendant, polished metal and lustrous organic stone.

This outfit embodies a refined classicism that stands out against the chaotic energy of a rock concert, perfectly honoring her request for a streamlined and traditional aesthetic. The tailored blazer and pleated trousers provide structure and comfort for walking extensively through crowds, while the earthy color palette offers a sophisticated contrast to typical loud stage lighting without appearing overly flashy. Choosing an autumn-appropriate fabric weight ensures warmth in the evening club atmosphere, yet the breathable silk blouse keeps her feeling fresh throughout the night."}
